statement.document_title: What if Generative AI turned out to be a Dud?

from_speaker: as smart and resourceful as humans if not more so
our_interpretation: Read the doubt as a directional forecast against human-level AGI arriving within the preceding two-to-three-year window.
Anchor the window to the post because the date of the referenced prediction is not supplied. The latest anniversary deadline is August 13, 2026.
Human-level AGI requires broad, adaptable competence. A product label, executive declaration, or single benchmark result does not establish it.
This evaluates the predicted event, not the calibration of an unstated probability.
criteria.support_condition: Evidence covering the deadline establishes that available leading systems still lacked human-level general competence under a defensible, broad assessment.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A system demonstrably attained human-level general competence on or before August 13, 2026, with independent evidence covering breadth, adaptation, and practical resourcefulness.

evidence.explanation: This provides pre-deadline evidence of a remaining capability gap. A July report on one benchmark cannot establish that no system achieved broad human-level competence by August 13.
This is material evidence of progress, but it was reported after the deadline without establishing the capability before it. The publisher also cautions that benchmark saturation does not prove AGI.
